chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 182: Ji Ning's Power-Up & The Limitless Foundation
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning distributes rewards, receives a Grand Xia map from Beishan Baiwei, refines a Miasma Treasure for a new assassination strategy, and pushes his cultivation past the legendary eight-hundred-jin Celestial Immortal foundation without reaching its limit. He also sends for his friend, Meng Yan.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 182: The Foundation That Breaks All Records
og_description: Ji Ning refines 800 jin of Primordial Liquid in one go, but his Zifu still isn't full. A new strategy with a Miasma Treasure and a heartwarming rescue for a friend makes this a chapter of pure Xianxia payoff.
twitter_title: The Miasma Assassin: Ji Ning's New Killer Combo
twitter_description: Ji Ning turns an escape tool into a close-range death sentence. Plus, an 800-jin cultivation session that hints at an unprecedented foundation.
